language.script_notes: Arabic script, read right to left, with English alongside on many road signs, though English appears less than in the wealthier Gulf states. Street-name terms include شارع (street), طريق (road), ميدان (square), دوار (roundabout) and جسر (bridge). The internet domain is .jo.

road_furniture.bollard_color: White posts with reflective striping; some sources describe them as black-and-white striped.
road_furniture.line_paint: Yellow edge lines with white centre lines.
road_furniture.curb_style: Divided highways have yellow-and-black painted curbs.
road_furniture.km_marker_style: Blue direction signs with white lettering in Arabic, English or both; main highways are marked with a green rectangle carrying a yellow number. Total, Manaseer Oil & Gas and JoPetro are common fuel-station brands.

architecture.distinctive_building_types: White water tanks sit on rooftops.

nature.vegetation: Sparse desert scrub across the arid east and south.
nature.terrain: Hot, dry and mountainous, with red sandstone gorges and desert in the south.

vehicles.plate_color: White with black text, usually wide and short but occasionally tall and narrow; commercial vehicles such as taxis and buses use green plates, diplomatic plates are yellow and government plates are red.
vehicles.plate_format: Latin letters and digits (a prefix number followed by up to five digits), in a font resembling British plates; special categories add Arabic text.

google_coverage.coverage_notes: An encyclopedic source describes official coverage as Trekker imagery of about 43 heritage sites (launched 2015: including Petra, Jerash, Umm Qais, Mount Nebo, the Dead Sea and Aqaba), not regular road coverage. Some GeoGuessr guides instead describe a black Street View car with Gen 3 road imagery; the two sources conflict and this is unverified.

confusion_set.shared_traits: Arabic and English signage, white plates, desert scenery, rooftop water tanks
confusion_set.tiebreaker: Far less English on signs, a poorer and more rugged look with mountains, and the Street View car is reported as black rather than white.

confusion_set.shared_traits: Neighbouring arid terrain, similar dry-hill vegetation
confusion_set.tiebreaker: White plates with Latin letters and digits versus yellow plates of hyphenated numerals, and Arabic-only rather than Hebrew-Arabic-English signs.

confusion_set.shared_traits: Arabic and English signage, arid mountains and desert
confusion_set.tiebreaker: Main highways here are marked with a green rectangle carrying a yellow number, and the terrain is mountainous rather than desert plains; Omani guardrails carry red-only reflectors.
